project_info.theme: First stop event announcement for VFE France study 2027 roadshow
project_info.color_palette: White, Navy Blue, Red, Sunset Gold, River Blue

main_subject.detail: A city-event poster announcing Đà Nẵng as the first stop of the VFE Du học Pháp 2027 event series, with a red map pin icon, event time and venue cards, and a wide sunset photograph of the Dragon Bridge across the lower half.
main_subject.style: City stop campaign poster with strong route branding, clear logistical information, and polished travel-photo integration.

items: Top Left: Small event-series logo block 'Chuỗi sự kiện DU HỌC PHÁP 2027' with tagline.
Top Right: VFE logo and two stacked rounded info cards for time/date and venue/address.
Bottom Left: Large red CTA button 'ĐĂNG KÝ NGAY >>>'.
Bottom Right: Wide panoramic sunset photo of the Dragon Bridge over the river.
Center/Background: White textured top half with big headline 'TRẠM DỪNG ĐẦU TIÊN ĐÀ NẴNG', red location pin, and bullet benefits.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: Bright campaign-poster lighting with sunset city photo
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean white poster contrast, vivid red location pin, and warm golden-hour scenic depth in the lower photo.

Background includes a warm sunset panoramic photo of the Dragon Bridge across the lower half. Surrounding elements: event-series mark 'Chuỗi sự kiện DU HỌC PHÁP 2027', bullet benefits, VFE logo, and red CTA 'ĐĂNG KÝ NGAY'. Technical style: photo-integrated event stop campaign poster, bright clean readability with scenic sunset integration, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
